_note: PROTOTYPE DEMO DATA. Program details must be verified with Batumi City Hall before any real use.

programs.name_ka: სამუშაოს მაძიებლად რეგისტრაცია (დასაქმების ხელშეწყობის სახელმწიფო სააგენტო)
programs.name_en: Jobseeker registration - State Employment Support Agency
programs.who: Unemployed or job-seeking residents of Georgia, 16+
programs.what: Registration as a jobseeker, job matching with employers, career consultation, access to state training and retraining programs for jobseekers.
programs.how: Register online at worknet.gov.ge or in person at a Public Service Hall / agency office in Batumi. Bring ID card.
programs.source: State programs for jobseekers' vocational training and retraining (matsne.gov.ge)

programs.name_ka: სამუშაოს მაძიებელთა პროფესიული მომზადება და გადამზადება
programs.name_en: State vocational training and retraining for jobseekers
programs.what: Free short vocational training and retraining courses in demand professions, delivered through authorized colleges and training providers.
programs.how: First register as a jobseeker (see above), then apply for a course through the agency consultant.
programs.source: Government of Georgia state program on vocational training, retraining and upskilling of jobseekers (matsne.gov.ge)

programs.name_ka: ბსუ-ს პროფესიული პროგრამებისა და უწყვეტი განათლების ცენტრი
programs.name_en: BSU Center for Vocational Programs and Lifelong Learning
programs.who: Adults and young people who want a profession or new qualification
programs.what: Vocational programs, professional training/retraining and short lifelong-learning courses.
programs.how: Contact the center at 15 Leonidze St., Batumi, or check bsu.edu.ge for current admissions.

programs.who: Young people and adults seeking vocational qualifications, including hospitality and tourism
programs.what: Vocational programs closely linked with employers; high demand from applicants.
programs.how: Apply during the vocational admission period; ask the college about short courses.
programs.source: UNDP Georgia story on vocational training

programs.who: People interested in working as seafarers
programs.what: Vocational maritime programs, seafarer training, retraining and certification. Year-round career path, not seasonal.
programs.how: Visit the school (Davit Mamuladze St. 29, Batumi), Mon-Fri 10:00-17:30.

programs.name_ka: დამწყები გიდების მომზადების პროგრამა (აჭარის ტურიზმის დეპარტამენტი)
programs.name_en: Training program for beginner tour guides (Adjara Tourism Department)
programs.who: People who want to work as tour guides, especially with language skills
programs.what: Professional training for beginner tourist guides launched in Batumi in 2026. Good option for off-season upskilling.
programs.how: Check the Adjara Tourism Department announcements for the next intake.

programs.who: Batumi residents in vulnerable situations: socially vulnerable families, people with disabilities, families with children with special needs, and others defined by each sub-program
programs.what: Municipal social support sub-programs funded by the 2026 municipal budget ('Social Security' program).
programs.how: Apply at Batumi City Hall, 25 Luka Asatiani St. Eligibility depends on the specific sub-program; a City Hall advisor confirms.

programs.who: Low-income families registered in the database of socially vulnerable families
programs.what: Monthly subsistence allowance based on a household rating score.
programs.how: Request a household assessment through the Social Service Agency or a Public Service Hall.
programs.source: General national program; verify current rules
